title: Estimating The Rate Of Complete Ablation (A0) With The Use Of Biomechanical Deformable Image Registration
official: Estimating The Rate Of Complete Ablation (A0) With The Use Of Biomechanical Deformable Image Registration
summary: The goal of this research study is to find out if using an updated version of standard computer software (called RayStation) for confirming that thermal ablation treatment was able to destroy all tumor cells including a safety margin.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with primary or secondary liver tumors referred for percutaneous thermal liver ablation as per the standard of care
2. ≤5 abatable tumors
3. Each tumor measuring ≤5 cm in its largest dimension
4. Ability to obtain a 5 mm MAM on pre- and intraprocedural CECT

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Age \<18 years old
2. Currently breastfeeding or pregnant
3. Unable to receive at least pre- and final post-ablation contrast-enhanced CT during the ablation procedure
